milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task where the player must navigate toward and visually observe the scaffolding blocks. The target is set to the center of the scaffolding cluster at spawn-relative (11, 1, 10), with max_distance=5 so the player must get reasonably close (spawn is ~15 blocks away, so this can't be satisfied from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 degrees to confirm they are looking at the scaffolding. This correctly models 'player has found and is looking at the scaffolding.'
